description: This file defines React components for a chat list interface, including individual chat items with drag-and-drop reordering, and integrates with application state via hooks. It handles rendering of chat sessions, user interactions such as selection and deletion, and styling.

methods.name: ChatItem
methods.description: React component representing an individual chat item with drag-and-drop capability, including display logic and interaction handlers.

methods.name: ChatList
methods.description: React component rendering a list of chat sessions, supporting drag-and-drop reordering, session selection, and deletion.
